inbox.title: Shared trips
inbox.description: Who wants to share trips with you, and what happened in shared trips.

requests.title: Requests
requests.body: {{name}} (@{{username}}) would like to share trips with you. If you agree, {{name}} can copy trips into your account — each one as your own trip.

notices.title: Notices
notices.left: {{name}} left the shared trip “{{trip}}”. {{name}} keeps their own copy.
notices.created: {{name}} added {{type}} “{{entry}}” to the shared trip. Your copy has been created.
notices.updated: {{name}} changed {{type}} “{{entry}}”. Your copy has been updated.
notices.deleted: {{name}} deleted {{type}} “{{entry}}”. Your copy stays — it is your call.
notices.movedOut: {{name}} took {{type}} “{{entry}}” out of the shared trip. Your copy stays — it is your call.
notices.joined: {{name}} added {{type}} “{{entry}}” to the shared trip. Your own entry is now linked to it.
notices.joinedMoved: {{name}} added {{type}} “{{entry}}” to the shared trip. Your own entry from “{{from}}” is now linked to this trip and was moved here.
notices.joinedMovedOnShare: {{name}} shared the trip with you. Your own entry “{{entry}}” from “{{from}}” is now linked to it and was moved here.
notices.conflict: {{name}} changed {{type}} “{{entry}}” differently at the same time. Nothing was overwritten – which value should stand?
notices.leftRevoked: {{name}} withdrew the consent to share. “{{trip}}” is no longer kept in step; your trip stays yours.
notices.addRequest: {{name}} asks you to share “{{trip}}” with {{person}} too.
notices.addRequestFrom: {{name}} asks you to share “{{trip}}” with {{person}} ({{personOrigin}}) too.
notices.addRequestHint: On the trip page you can offer it to a connected person, or create a code for this trip and pass it on.

empty.title: Nothing new
empty.description: Sharing requests and notices about shared trips appear here.

messages.accepted: Agreed — {{name}} can now share trips with you.
messages.undone: Undone — the others see it as your change.
messages.resolved: Decided – the others get the value as your change.

shareDialog.title: Share trip with {{name}}
shareDialog.copied: {{name}} gets their own copy of this trip: flights, stays, cruises, train, bus and ferry rides, rentals and stops with their times, places and status. When one of you changes something later, it reaches everyone and can be undone in the inbox.
shareDialog.private: Staying private: seat, cabin and room, your price, booking references, ratings, notes, photos, journal and documents.
shareDialog.final: This cannot be taken back: {{name}} keeps the copy even if one of you leaves the shared trip.
shareDialog.nobody: Right now you can't share this trip with anyone. Link travellers to their account — that works once they have accepted your request.

add.title: These accounts have agreed to share with you but are not travellers on this trip yet. Add a person and link them — then you can share the trip with them.
add.actionLabel: Add {{name}} as a traveller and link their account
add.addFailed: {{name}} could not be added as a traveller. Nothing was changed.
add.linkFailed: {{name}} is now a traveller, but linking their account did not work. Please try again.
add.reloadFailed: {{name}} is added and linked, but the list could not be reloaded. Close the dialog and open it again.
add.nameTaken: The name “{{name}}” already belongs to a traveller linked to another account. Rename that traveller on the trip — then you can add {{name}}.

blocked.notLinked: {{name}} is not linked to an account.
blocked.consentMissing: {{name}} has not agreed to share with you yet. You have not sent a request yet — you can do that under Settings → Trips → Share trips.
blocked.consentDeclined: {{name}} declined your request to share. You can send a new request under Settings → Trips → Share trips.
blocked.consentWithdrawn: The agreement to share between you and {{name}} was withdrawn. You can send a new request under Settings → Trips → Share trips.
blocked.consentPending: Your request to {{name}} is still open.
blocked.groupConsentMissing: {{name}} first has to connect with everyone who already shares this trip.
blocked.alreadyMember: {{name}} is already part of this shared trip.

linkDialog.title: Link {{name}} to an account
linkDialog.requestIntro: Nobody has accepted your request yet. Send {{name}} a request by username; once they accept, you can link here.

dialog.title: Create a public link
dialog.warning: Anyone with the link sees the chosen details – without signing in, until the link expires or you revoke it. Nothing else is reachable through it.
dialog.preview: Preview – exactly what anyone opening the link sees
dialog.previewFailed: The preview could not be loaded.
dialog.created: The link is shown only now – copy it now. Later you can only revoke it and create a new one.
dialog.copyFailed: Copying failed – select the link and copy it by hand.
dialog.disabled: Public links are disabled. An administrator can enable them under Administration → Instance → Public links.
dialog.statusFailed: Could not check whether public links are allowed.

dialog.itineraryHint: Shows every entry of the trip on local time – flight numbers, stays with their address, train, bus, ferry, rental car, cruise ports – and what is happening now. Never booking numbers, seat, room or cabin numbers, prices, documents, notes or companions. The link ends at the latest 24 hours after the trip's last day.

remote.title: Companions on other servers
remote.description: Share trips with people whose account is on another TravStats server. You connect with an invitation code; your server's admin must have added their server as trusted first.

invites.title: Invitation code
invites.hint: Create a code and pass it on another way (a message, a call). The person redeems it on their own server. Each code works once, for 72 hours.
invites.codeHint: Shown only now – copy it right away. Valid until {{date}}.
invites.revoked: Code withdrawn. It can no longer be redeemed.

claim.label: Code from someone on another server

people.title: Connected people
people.withdrawConfirm: Afterwards nothing from {{name}} reaches you and nothing from you reaches {{name}}. Shared trips stay with both of you as your own trips. Withdraw?
people.withdrawn: Consent for {{name}} ({{origin}}) withdrawn. Their server is told.
